title: Intro to Prompt Engineering
description: Master the art of communicating with Large Language Models. Learn Zero-Shot, Few-Shot, and Chain of Thought prompting.

lessons.title: What is a Prompt?
lessons.content: A prompt is the text inputs sent to an LLM. It acts as the instruction manual, contextual backdrop, and data source all in one.

lessons.title: Zero-Shot vs Few-Shot Prompting
lessons.content: Zero-shot prompting performs tasks directly. Few-shot prompting provides one or more examples to demonstrate desired behaviors.

questions.question: Which prompting technique involves providing example input-output pairs to guide the model?
questions.explanation: Few-shot prompting provides example pairs directly in the prompt context to guide the model's output layout.

title: Generative AI for Creators
description: Unlock creative workflows. Master Midjourney, DALL-E, and prompt patterns for generating art, audio, and video designs.

lessons.title: Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
lessons.content: Diffusion models generate images by iteratively removing Gaussian noise guided by a text prompt embedding.

title: Python for Machine Learning
description: Master the foundational Python skills needed for machine learning, including NumPy and Pandas.

lessons.title: Variables and Data Types
lessons.content: Learn how to store and manipulate data using core Python data types.

lessons.title: Loops and Functions
lessons.content: Write reusable code blocks and iterate over data structures.

lessons.title: NumPy Arrays
lessons.content: Perform fast numerical operations with NumPy arrays.

lessons.title: Pandas DataFrames
lessons.content: Analyze and clean tabular data using Pandas.

questions.question: Which library is best for numerical operations?
questions.explanation: NumPy is optimized for fast array and numerical operations.

questions.question: What is a DataFrame?
questions.explanation: A DataFrame is a 2D labeled data structure in Pandas.

questions.question: Which keyword defines a function in Python?
questions.explanation: The def keyword is used to create a function.

title: Advanced Machine Learning
description: Dive deep into predictive modeling, ensemble methods, and hyperparameter tuning.

lessons.title: Random Forests
lessons.content: Combine multiple decision trees to improve model accuracy.

lessons.title: Gradient Boosting
lessons.content: Learn how boosting reduces bias and variance.

lessons.title: Grid Search
lessons.content: Systematically find the best hyperparameters.

lessons.title: Cross-Validation
lessons.content: Evaluate model performance robustly across different data splits.

questions.question: What does cross-validation help prevent?
questions.explanation: Cross-validation evaluates how well the model generalizes to unseen data.

questions.question: Which method builds trees sequentially?
questions.explanation: Boosting builds trees sequentially, whereas Random Forest builds them independently.

questions.question: What is the purpose of Grid Search?
questions.explanation: Grid search tests different combinations of parameters to find the best configuration.

title: AI Strategy for Managers
description: Learn how to implement AI solutions to drive business value and optimize operations.

lessons.title: Business Use Cases
lessons.content: Identify areas where AI can reduce costs and increase revenue.

lessons.title: ROI of AI Projects
lessons.content: Calculate the return on investment for AI implementations.

lessons.title: Building Data Teams
lessons.content: Structure your data science and engineering teams for success.

lessons.title: Agile for AI
lessons.content: Adapt agile methodologies for uncertain AI projects.

questions.question: What is a key metric for AI project success in business?
questions.explanation: Business projects must ultimately deliver positive ROI.

questions.question: Which role focuses on deploying models?
questions.explanation: ML Engineers focus on scaling and deploying models into production.

questions.question: Why is agile challenging for AI?
questions.explanation: Research and development in AI often has uncertain timelines and outcomes.

title: Generative AI in Marketing
description: Leverage LLMs and image generators to scale content creation and marketing campaigns.

lessons.title: Copywriting with LLMs
lessons.content: Generate blog posts and ad copy using AI tools.

lessons.title: Visual Assets
lessons.content: Create engaging images for social media campaigns.

lessons.title: A/B Testing with AI
lessons.content: Use AI to analyze split test results faster.

lessons.title: Personalization
lessons.content: Tailor marketing messages to individual customer segments.

questions.question: How can AI help with copywriting?
questions.explanation: AI models can rapidly generate text drafts and brainstorm ideas.

questions.question: What is A/B testing?
options: Testing two different versions to see which performs better
questions.explanation: A/B testing compares two variations to determine which yields better results.

questions.question: What is the benefit of personalization?
questions.explanation: Personalization makes content more relevant, increasing user engagement.

title: Intro to Reinforcement Learning
description: Understand the basics of agents, environments, rewards, and Q-learning algorithms.

lessons.title: Markov Decision Processes
lessons.content: Formalize decision making using states, actions, and transitions.

lessons.title: Reward Functions
lessons.content: Design reward signals to guide agent behavior effectively.

lessons.title: Q-Learning Basics
lessons.content: Learn the foundational algorithm for value-based RL.

lessons.title: Exploration vs Exploitation
lessons.content: Balance trying new actions versus using known rewarding actions.

questions.question: What does MDP stand for?
questions.explanation: MDP stands for Markov Decision Process.

questions.question: What is the goal of an RL agent?
questions.explanation: Agents aim to maximize their expected cumulative reward over time.

questions.question: What is the exploration-exploitation tradeoff?
options: Balancing discovering new info vs using known info
questions.explanation: It is the dilemma of choosing between gathering new information (exploration) and capitalizing on existing knowledge (exploitation).

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning
description: Combine neural networks with RL to solve complex, high-dimensional environments.

lessons.title: Neural Nets as Function Approximators
lessons.content: Use deep learning to approximate Q-values for large state spaces.

lessons.title: Experience Replay
lessons.content: Stabilize training by storing and sampling past transitions.

lessons.title: Introduction to Policy Optimization
lessons.content: Directly optimize the policy instead of value functions.

lessons.title: PPO and TRPO
lessons.content: Advanced algorithms for stable policy updates.

questions.question: Why use Experience Replay in DQN?
options: To break correlation between consecutive samples
questions.explanation: Experience replay breaks temporal correlations, making learning more stable.

questions.question: What do policy gradient methods optimize?
questions.explanation: They directly optimize the parameterized policy to maximize expected returns.

questions.question: What does PPO stand for?
questions.explanation: PPO stands for Proximal Policy Optimization.
